foreign_courtage.basis: UNVERIFIED (2026-09-28, ADR 0005): a search-engine extract of Avanza's price list for foreign trading (avanza.se is not reachable from the development container): 0.25 %, minimum 1 USD for US shares, and the same in CAD for Canadian shares (the CAD minimum is assumed equal). The FX fee is this file's fx_fee_rate. Check against Avanza's 'Prislista för utlandshandel' and set verified_on.

basis: Nasdaq Stockholm (main market) courtage from the owner's screenshot of Avanza's price list, 2026-09-26: 'Start. För dig som gör små affärer. 100% återbetalning av fondavgifter. Valbar om du har under 50 000 kr*' - rörligt courtage 0 %, lägsta courtage 0 kr. The footnote (*) was not in the screenshot. Other marketplaces cost more (Spotlight Stock Market from 19 kr, First North from 1 kr); backtests only accept main-market instruments. FX fee: the owner confirmed on 2026-09-26 that Start has no FX fee while the capital stays under the class limit (over it, Start can't be kept and the new class's fee applies; backtests note that crossing). Slippage, half-spread and participation cap are modelling choices.
